resources.title: Strawbees & Cardboard Box Ping-Pong Ball Track
resources.description: The goal of this challenge was to design the longest possible ping-pong ball track. Groups only had a short amount of time to get a working track, and needed to initialise the ping-pong ball using a littleBits cloudbit (either by fan, servo, or another bit) and end the track by depositing the ping-pong ball in a plastic cup.
